# 1. Offer Letter — Draft, जारी न करें जब तक `[ ]` clear न हो

**Brightwater Analytics India Pvt. Ltd.**
Registered Office: Pune, Maharashtra
Date: 10 November 2025

To: Mr. John Stiles, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Re: Offer of Employment — REQ-2291

Dear John,

We are pleased to offer you employment with **Brightwater Analytics India Pvt. Ltd.** (Indian entity) on the following terms:

**1. Position**
**Software Engineer II (L4)**, full-time, permanent, reporting to Mary Major, Engineering Manager. **[TITLE TO CONFIRM: Recruiter promised “Senior Software Engineer” — not approved. Do not issue until title confirmed per Cover Note.]**
Work base: remote based at Bengaluru, Karnataka.

**2. Compensation**
Fixed annual CTC: **₹[ ___ to be inserted after fresh written approval — currently approved L4 India-remote band is ₹32,00,000 – ₹38,00,000; ₹40,00,000 is NOT approved]** payable per Company payroll.

**3. ESOP**
**[3,200 options]** under Brightwater ESOP Plan 2023, 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff, subject to Plan rules and grant documents. **[4,000 options NOT approved — 3,200 approved by Nomination and Remuneration Committee on 28 Oct; any increase needs fresh Committee approval.]**

**4. Joining Bonus**
₹4,00,000 (maximum approved) with first regular salary, subject to tax. If you voluntarily resign within 12 months of joining, you will repay on pro-rata basis: `₹4,00,000 × (12 − completed months) / 12`. No deduction from full-and-final without your separate written authorization.

**5. Start Date**
**1 December 2025 (Monday)**, subject to contingencies below and production of relieving letter for last day 28 November 2025.

**6. Benefits**
You will be eligible for Company benefits as detailed in the India Benefits Guide, which should be read with this letter.

**7. Contingencies**
This offer is conditional on satisfactory background verification and your production of identity / educational documents and relieving letter from your current employer; failure may lead to withdrawal / termination.

**8. Probation**
6 months from joining, per Company policy.

**9. Notice and Termination**
No at-will employment applies. During probation, 30 days’ notice by either side; after confirmation, 60 days’ notice or salary in lieu; misconduct termination per Company disciplinary procedure.

**10. Governing Law**
Indian law applies; exclusive jurisdiction of competent courts at Pune, Maharashtra.

**11. Acceptance**
Please sign and return by **[14 November 2025]**. During employment you will work exclusively for the Company and maintain confidentiality; no post-employment non-compete is imposed.

For Brightwater Analytics India Pvt. Ltd.
*[Authorised Signatory, Name / Title]*

Accepted: _________________ Date: _______

# 2. Cover Note — Mary Major के लिए

**Subject: REQ-2291 — Recruiter के वादे vs Approved terms, जारी करने से पहले सुधार आवश्यक**

वादे (7 Nov मौखिक) approved शर्तों से अधिक हैं। बिना fresh approval offer न भेजें:

1. **Title:** वादा Senior Software Engineer vs approved Software Engineer II (L4)। सिफारिश: approved title पर offer दें या Senior के लिए VP Engineering + Finance से fresh approval लें।
2. **Fixed CTC ₹40L** vs approved band ₹32-38L। सिफारिश: ₹40L न लिखें; या तो ≤₹38L पर negotiate करें या VP Engineering + Finance से band-exception approval लें।
3. **ESOP 4,000** vs approved 3,200 (NRC, 28 Oct)। सिफारिश: 3,200 ही लिखें; वृद्धि हेतु Nomination and Remuneration Committee से fresh approval लें।
4. **Non-compete 12 माह post-employment:** Sec 27, Indian Contract Act के तहत void; candidate ने हटाने को कहा था। सिफारिश: हटाएँ, केवल during-employment exclusivity + confidentiality रखें।
5. **Bonus full clawback:** Sec 74 के विरुद्ध; Company practice pro-rata है। सिफारिश: Legal वाला pro-rata clause ही रखें।
6. **Texas law / Travis County:** Sec 28 के तहत अप्रवर्तनीय। सिफारिश: Indian law + Pune exclusive jurisdiction रखें।
7. **At-will:** भारत में मान्य नहीं। सिफारिश: 30 दिन (probation) / 60 दिन (confirmation) notice standard रखें।

**Sign-off:** Title/CTC हेतु VP Engineering + Finance; ESOP हेतु NRC; final draft हेतु Legal; option-चयन हेतु आप। तब Authorised Signatory हस्ताक्षर करे।

*शब्द संख्या: ~210*

# 3. Joining-Bonus वापसी — Worked Example

Bonus: ₹4,00,000, शर्त: 12 माह के भीतर स्वैच्छिक इस्तीफे पर pro-rata वापसी।

फॉर्मूला: `वापसी = 4,00,000 × (12 − पूरे किए माह) / 12`

यदि 7 पूरे माह बाद इस्तीफा: सेवा 7/12, शेष 5/12।

> ₹4,00,000 × 5 / 12 = **₹1,66,667** (लगभग)

यह राशि full-and-final से स्वतः नहीं काटी जाएगी; अलग लिखित authorization आवश्यक है।
